summary: Frontend verification of invite-gate bug fix. Confirmed: (1) GET /api/gate/status returns {enabled:false, has_owner:true}. (2) Loading root URL '/' routes via splash to '/passcode' (data-testid='pac-screen') and invite-screen is NOT rendered. (3) Tapping pac-key-1..pac-key-6 unlocks the app, PAC screen disappears, and the main tabbed app renders with Home/Payments/Cards/Insights/Products tabs and expected home content ('Hi John', account balance €3475.00, activity feed).
test_credentials: PAC unlock: any 6 digits (used 1,2,3,4,5,6). No invite code required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invite gate is disabled in DB. If tests fail with invite-screen showing, verify GET /api/gate/status returns enabled=false. App uses Expo Router; verify via data-testid and DOM text, not screenshot pixels (though in this run screenshot also rendered correctly).
rca of the issue: Root cause was gate_config.enabled=True in MongoDB while current browser was not the registered owner device, forcing the /invite screen. Mitigation: set gate_config.enabled=False. Verified via API and UI flow.
